people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: They brought what Moses commanded before the Tent of Meeting. All the congregation came near and stood before Yahweh.
translations.bsb: So they took what Moses had commanded to the front of the Tent of Meeting, and the whole congregation drew near and stood before the LORD.
translations.kjv: And they brought that which Moses commanded before the tabernacle of the congregation: and all the congregation drew near and stood before the LORD.
translations.asv: And they brought that which Moses commanded before the tent of meeting: and all the congregation drew near and stood before Jehovah.
